name: corpus-rag
description: Ask cited questions, search your corpus, ingest documents, run chunk coding, run the UX research study layer, and set studies up in research folders with the Corpus-KB engine, one study at a time.
author: moliver28

engine_root.description: Corpus-KB engine checkout folder. Leave empty to use the plugin's resolution chain.

app_dsn_template.description: Postgres DSN template for study databases; {database} is replaced with the study's database name.

superuser_dsn.description: Postgres superuser DSN for provision, migrate, and backup.

base_port.description: First port to try for study servers.

default_backend.description: Storage backend for new studies: postgres or duckdb.

uxr_report_tool.description: Report tool command line for the UXR contract test, like 'python tools/report.py'. Leave empty to use --evidence-file.
